# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.
#
# Ranking is the engine's: `ordered_in_global_list` takes `order_by` as a script
# value and sorts highest first -- vanilla proves the direction by writing
# `multiply = -1` on the one place it wants the weakest -- and pairs `max` with
# `check_range_bounds = no` when the list may be shorter than asked for.
#
# Scope: country
bag_wtp_clear_rows = {
	set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_found value = 0 }
	every_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_row_taken_locations
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_row_taken
		remove_variable = bag_wtp_rank
	}
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_row_taken_locations
	# `_ranked` is the answer and survives; `_results` is the copy the window
	# repeats over, and it only exists while the window is open -- emptying the
	# datamodel is the only thing that frees a scripted widget's rows.
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_ranked
	clear_global_variable_list = bag_wtp_results
}

# Scope: country
bag_wtp_fill_rows = {
	# `max` counts locations walked, not rows produced. Every location of a
	# province scores the same and only the first of them takes a row, so fifty
	# would have stopped at about a dozen provinces -- which is what the fifth run
	# showed. Eight locations per province is above the game's widest.
	ordered_in_global_list = {
		variable = bag_wtp_candidates
		order_by = bag_wtp_score
		max = 400
		check_range_bounds = no
		bag_wtp_store_row = yes
	}
}

# Park one province's answer on the location the ranking kept, and remember that
# location in rank order.
#
# One row per province definition -- the province as the map draws it, whole,
# rather than the piece of it one country owns. The game splits a province by
# ownership: half of Bessarabia under Moldavia is its own `province`, named
# "Moldavian province Bessarabia", and the other half is another. Every location
# of one piece scores the same, so a row per piece is several ways of saying one
# thing -- and worse, the number itself would move on the day the pieces join,
# which is exactly the day this mod is planning for.
#
# Taken is marked on the locations rather than on the definition: a location
# certainly holds a variable, and this pass already has every one of them.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_row = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			global_var:bag_wtp_found < 50
			# Nothing won here on either side -- every method for this good is behind
			# an advance this country has not taken. A row for it would have no
			# building and no method to print.
			OR = {
				var:bag_wtp_best_method > 0
				var:bag_wtp_best_method_rural > 0
			}
			NOT = { has_variable = bag_wtp_row_taken }
		}
		province_definition = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_row_taken value = 1 }
				add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_row_taken_locations target = this }
			}
		}
		# The winners are parked first and the row decided afterwards, because
		# «is this province worth a row» is a question about the bonus, and the
		# bonus is not known until the method that won is.
		bag_wtp_store_winner = yes
		bag_wtp_store_winner_rural = yes
		if = {
			limit = { bag_wtp_row_is_worth_it = yes }
			change_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_found add = 1 }
			# The place in the ranking, written down where the row can print it. The
			# order a list is built in is not an order anything downstream promises
			# to keep, so the answer says its own rank rather than where it sits.
			set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_rank value = global_var:bag_wtp_found }
			add_to_global_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_ranked target = this }
		}
	}
}
